##### Project general facts

Hammock Park is a contemporary residential development by Devmark that combines modern architecture, premium comfort, and exceptional functionality in one of Dubai's rapidly growing communities. Designed across nine residential floors, the project offers an elegant collection of residences where clean architectural lines, spacious layouts, and light-filled interiors create a welcoming atmosphere for modern urban living. Every detail has been thoughtfully considered to deliver a harmonious balance between sophisticated design and everyday practicality.

Residents enjoy a lifestyle centered around comfort, convenience, and quality. The development is strategically located with excellent connectivity to Dubai's key destinations while offering a peaceful residential environment. Carefully designed communal spaces and premium amenities complement the living experience, creating a vibrant community where residents can relax, socialize, and enjoy a balanced lifestyle in a contemporary setting.

The residences are finished with high-quality materials and refined contemporary detailing, featuring bright open-plan interiors and elegant finishes throughout. Designer kitchens are fully equipped with premium German appliances, kitchen islands, granite countertops, hidden storage solutions, and soft-close cabinetry, combining style with outstanding functionality. Each residence is delivered fully furnished and equipped, while the luxury bathrooms are fitted with premium Bagno Design fixtures, ensuring a move-in-ready home that reflects comfort and sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
